item.title: CFP Special Issue of JPS on Aesthetic Education and Philosophy in Schools
item.description:
CALL FOR PAPERS

The Journal of Philosophy in Schools (JPS) is seeking articles for inclusion in a special issue entitled Aesthetic Education and Philosophy in Schools.

Aesthetic education is often treated as a concern of the arts curriculum alone — a matter of what happens in the music room, the drama studio, or the visual arts classroom. Yet the claim that education has an aesthetic dimension is older and broader than this narrower usage suggests.
